headline: 今日影视动态：零新片上映，多片热议
headlineEn: Today's Film News: Zero New Releases, Multiple Trending Titles
summary: 7月25日无新片上映，本周仅有2部新片。《低弧慢球》《斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙》等领跑今日热搜，《奥德赛》《揭秘日》本周持续火热。
summaryEn: No new films released on July 25, only two this week. 'Low Arc Slow Ball' and 'Stuart Could Not Save the Universe' top today's trends, while 'Odyssey' and 'Revelation Day' remain hot this week.
